Jonathan J. Rasouli, MD
https://rasouli-md.com/

Jonathan J. Rasouli, MD, FAANS is a board-certified, fellowship-trained spinal neurosurgeon. He practices with NeuroSpine Plus and specializes in complex spinal deformity, minimally invasive spine surgery (including endoscopic techniques), and robotic-assisted spine procedures. The site states that he favors conservative care first and recommends surgery when it is the option that will help.

Training and certification, as published on this site:
- Complex Spinal Surgery Fellowship, Cleveland Clinic, 2019–2020
- Neurological Surgery Residency, The Mount Sinai Hospital, 2012–2019, including a Stereotactic and Functional Neurosurgery Fellowship, 2015–2016
- M.D., Albert Einstein College of Medicine; Alpha Omega Alpha, 2011
- Board certified by the American Board of Neurological Surgery
- NPI 1003172974
- Castle Connolly Top Doctor 2023–2026 and Castle Connolly Rising Star 2023
- NJ Top Docs Top Doctor 2027

Services listed on this site:
- Complex spinal deformity (adult scoliosis, kyphosis, spinal imbalance, revision surgery)
- Minimally invasive surgery (endoscopic spine surgery, tubular retractors, microdiscectomy)
- Robotic-assisted surgery
- Spinal stenosis (laminectomy, laminotomy, spinal fusion, conservative care)
- Second opinion and revision spinal surgery
- Spinal trauma and tumors (fracture stabilization, tumor resection, spinal reconstruction)
